mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply ( message_id, user_id, content, create_time, update_time, status ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW(), #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.message_id, r.user_id, r.content, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.status, u.username, u.teamname FROM reply r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC
